about: A fictional voice note for D01 T03 §3: a caller claiming to be the managing director asks an accounts clerk to pay a new account today. Every name, company and number is invented. Spoken by Windows' own voices (System.Speech) through scripts/fixtures/make-voice.ts.

turns.text: Hi Thandi, it's Pieter Botha, the managing director of Karoo Fresh Produce. I'm boarding a flight, so listen carefully.
Hello Mr Botha. How can I help?
Our supplier changed banks. Please pay the forty eight thousand rand invoice into the new account today, before two o'clock. The account number is six two one, four four zero, nine one seven.
Today? Shouldn't I phone the supplier first to confirm?
No, there's no time. Do it now and keep it between us. I'll sign it off when I land.
